The '''Sphere of Sith Philosophy''', also known as the '''Ministry of Sith Philosophy''' and the '''Pyramid of Sith Philosophy''', was one of the twelve [[Spheres of Influence]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The pyramid was concerned with upholding the [[Code of the Sith/Legends|Sith code]] among the [[Sith Order]] and the denizens of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Sympathizers of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] would be hunted down and rooted out, regardless of their [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]]. This included those who wished to proselytize alternate philosophy or theology that directly contested or challenged the validity of the Sith. The Sphere was also responsible for spreading [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi sentiment]] and dictating the "proper" way to practice the Sith code. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], [[Darth Aruk]]&mdash;the [[Dark Council]]or in charge of the Sphere&mdash;worked to destroy the [[Order of Revan|Revanites]] for spreading their teachings across the Empire.

After the Empire's defeat at the hands of the [[Eternal Empire]], this sphere was combined along with the [[Sphere of Ancient Knowledge]] and [[Sphere of Mysteries]] into the [[Sphere of Sith Doctrine]].<ref name="SOTG" />
